verdict.rationale: Game engines can plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this question applies to Bevy. Nothing in the evidence shows Bevy includes one: the docs describe a code-first Rust engine with no editor, and the probes find no llms.txt or official MCP. Community Bevy Remote Protocol tooling is a third-party building block, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit.
